binaries.pulse_app: target/debug/pulse-app.exe built from clean HEAD b08e10a (pre-fix)
binaries.sidecar: target/debug/andromeda-pulse-mcp.exe rebuilt at clean HEAD b08e10a with --features mcp-server (pre-fix)

conditions.data_dir: <scratchpad>/wka-capture (one dir shared by app and sidecar)
conditions.seed: cargo run -p ingest --example inject_demo — retry storm, ~4600 spans / ~960 exception events

independent_corpus_read.method: direct read-only sqlite3 query of {data_dir}/corpus/corpus.db — does not go through the sidecar
independent_corpus_read.note: the app stamps the DETECTED PROJECT ROOT, Windows verbatim-prefixed — not the data dir

sidecar_query_incident_list.method: line-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio; initialize then tools/call
sidecar_query_incident_list.gates: compile-time --features mcp-server AND runtime ANDROMEDA_PULSE_MCP_ENABLED=true (both required)

verdict.statement: Against one data dir holding 2 active incidents, the pre-fix sidecar returns total: 0. The two numbers together rule out the alternative explanation that no incidents were created. F10 was previously DERIVED from code reading only; this is the observation.
